'''Todd Schnitzer''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Clifton Park tournament]] in December 2000 with Skum, according to Brian Terwilliger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1586">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-twigg-the-battle-for-reflections-2d1586/ twigg-the-battle-for-reflections-2], DeckTech (Brian "twigg" Terwilliger, 31 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-twigg-the-battle-for-reflections-2d1586/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
